meta.title: OCHA FTS funding to Lebanon by source donor
meta.license_note: FTS terms of use: reuse with attribution to UN OCHA Financial Tracking Service (fts.unocha.org); no explicit licence text on the API; facts only, no prose copied
meta.year_basis: FTS usage year (the API year filter), not the donation date; 2026 is a partial year to 2026-10-05
meta.total_definition: Sum of incoming paid and committed flows whose boundary is single (Lebanon only). Pledges excluded. Equals the FTS groupby total in every year (checked).
meta.headline_difference: headline_total_usd is the FTS flow-summary incoming total; it differs from total_usd in 2017, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2025 by flows that are shared across countries.
meta.double_counting: Flows of type Pass through (a UN agency or pooled fund passing money on to a partner) are inside total_usd, so one dollar can appear once as donor to agency and again as agency to partner. by_flow_type_usd shows the pass-through share; donors file has usd_excl_pass_through. Never add IATI or OECD ODA to these totals.
meta.recipient_lists: top_recipients and by_recipient_type are FTS report2 (first-level recipient organisation, pooled funds shown as recipients). top_recipients_final and by_recipient_type_final are report3, where pooled fund money appears at the organisations that received it from the fund (observed in 2023: Lebanon Humanitarian Fund is a top recipient in report2 and absent from report3; FTS documentation not read).
meta.recipient_adjustment: recipient_shared_or_overlap_adjustment_usd = total minus the sum of listed recipients; FTS reports shared and overlap amounts separately.
meta.groupby_crosscheck: Donor totals aggregated from flows match the FTS groupby report in every year except 2021, where one donor differs by 75,000 USD.
meta.self_reported: Funding is reported voluntarily by donors and recipients to FTS; it is incomplete (not all Gulf, bilateral, development or diaspora money) and is money moved, not outcomes.
meta.donor_note: Donors are the FTS source organisation of each flow. UN agencies, pooled funds and NGOs appear as sources when they pass money on; use usd_excl_pass_through for original donors.
